project_type: Python robotics hackathon repo (NormaCore ElRobot follower arm, 8 ST3215 servos, joint 8 = gripper, normalised 0..1 goals) driven through a small library src/normakit with sim (pybullet) and real (NormaCore Station) backends. New deliverable: a self-contained web application layer in ONE new top-level folder webapp/.
language: Python 3.10.12 (.venv), vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend (no build step, no npm)
build_system: none (plain python scripts; entry points run with .venv/bin/python)
test_framework: pytest 9.0.3 (installed in .venv); existing baseline test is scripts/selftest_sim.py (plain script, exits 0/1); new tests go in webapp/tests/ using fastapi.testclient.TestClient (httpx 0.28.1 present)
build_command: no build; syntax sanity via .venv/bin/python -m py_compile webapp/*.py
verification_instructions: 1) .venv/bin/python -m pytest webapp/tests -q passes (no hardware, no API key; anthropic client mocked). 2) .venv/bin/python scripts/selftest_sim.py still passes (it is UNTOUCHED). 3) Boot: .venv/bin/python webapp/run.py --backend sim --port 8920 then curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8920/ returns 200 and curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8920/api/status returns JSON with backend=sim. Kill the server afterwards.
setup_instructions: Nothing to install: .venv (symlink to ../hacklab-normacore-kit/.venv) already has fastapi 0.136.3, uvicorn 0.46.0, websockets 12.0, anthropic 2.10.0, httpx 0.28.1, pytest 9.0.3, pybullet, pillow, numpy, opencv. webapp/requirements.txt is written for documentation only (fastapi, uvicorn[standard], anthropic, pytest) - do NOT pip install into the shared venv.
environment_constraints: HARD: only ADD new files. Never edit/delete/move any existing file or folder except ONE appended entry at the top of CHANGELOG.md (AGENTS.md rule 8 requires documenting every change there; append-only) and ONE new docs page docs/13_WEB_VOICE_CONSOLE.md. src/normakit/core.py safety limits are read-only (AGENTS.md). The working tree has the team's uncommitted changes (deleted dotfiles, modified run/duster_offset.json, showcase/index.html, untracked results/run/showcase files) - leave them exactly as they are; stage ONLY webapp/, docs/13_WEB_VOICE_CONSOLE.md, CHANGELOG.md (never git add -A or git add .). .agents/ is untracked task state - never commit it. This laptop has NO working NVIDIA driver; voice v1 = browser Web Speech API (STT) + speechSynthesis (TTS), zero GPU. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY comes from the shell env only; never write keys to files/logs; server must boot and serve UI without a key (chat then returns a clear 'set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' message). The real arm must not move without a human at the table; e-stop is the servo power plug, software stop is a convenience. One writer on the bus: Station web UI control panel must be closed while the webapp drives (station mode). No fine-tuning path may be introduced: Claude API is the only model used; document this.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: document every change in CHANGELOG.md (append to the '## [Unreleased] - 2026-11-22' -> '### Added' section, newest-first bullet list, terse factual style ending with ' - Claude' per existing entries); every problem in docs/ISSUES.md (only if a real problem is hit). Team rule (docs/NEXT_AGENT_PROMPT.md): no Claude attribution in COMMIT MESSAGES (changelog bullets keep the existing ' - Claude' convention). Commit style on main: plain descriptive sentence(s), no conventional-commit prefixes. Never push (orchestrator handles push/PR). Existing station-mode scripts gate real-arm motion behind --i-have-a-human (scripts/run_policy.py lines 76-82, scripts/run_throw.py lines 154-169): mirror this - webapp refuses --backend station without --i-have-a-human, and additionally requires a per-session human-presence confirmation in the UI before any motion tool is forwarded (10-minute window, mirroring the team's ARM-motion protocol at :8890).
key_patterns: Backend selection everywhere is --backend sim|station (mcp_server.build(backend, host) in src/normakit/mcp_server.py returns a started Arm). FastAPI pattern: server/policy_server.py - sys.path.insert(0, ../src), create_app(...) factory, env-var config, bind 127.0.0.1 by default, uvicorn.run in main(). Claude agent loop: src/normakit/agent.py defines MODEL (env NORMA_MODEL, default claude-sonnet-5-5), SYSTEM, TOOLS (8 tools: look/pick_cell/place_cell/reach_cell/gripper/home/arm_state/stop) and run_tool(arm, name, args) -> json string or [image content block]; agent.run() is the sync tool-use loop - the webapp reuses SYSTEM/TOOLS/run_tool with its own event-emitting loop (cannot edit agent.py). Arm (src/normakit/arm.py): look(camera, grid)->jpeg bytes, state()->ArmState.to_json(), home(), pick(u,v), place(u,v), reach_cell(cell), open/close_gripper(), guard.estop()/release(); all motion goes through Guard (clamp 0.02..0.98, step limit 0.35, 10 Hz, overcurrent estop). SimBackend (src/normakit/sim_backend.py): cameras 'table'/'wrist', frame_jpeg 640x480. StationBackend (src/normakit/station_backend.py): cameras cam0.., front_camera(be) helper picks the table camera; host default localhost:8888. vision.grid_overlay(jpeg)->(jpeg, {A1..H6: (cx,cy)}). Sim has red_block, green_block, blue_tray; demo task 'put the red block in the blue tray'.
